mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.subject_name, s.subject_category, s.department_id, d.department_name, d.use_yn AS department_use_yn, s.grade, s.semester, s.use_yn, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM subject s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY d.department_name COLLATE "C", s.grade, s.subject_name COLLATE "C", s.use_yn DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT g::int FROM subject, unnest(string_to_array(grade, ',')) AS g WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT subject_category FROM subject WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND (',' || grade || ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{grade}, ',%')

SELECT s.id, s.subject_name, s.subject_category, s.department_id, d.department_name, s.grade, s.use_yn, s.created_at, s.updated_at, COUNT(e.id) AS exam_count FROM subject s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.id JOIN exam e ON e.subject_id = s.id AND e.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE s.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY s.id, d.department_name ORDER BY exam_count DESC, s.subject_name COLLATE "C" LIMIT #{limit}
